what: The arrow inside the square box beside a button or link is pushed out one cell (100%) in the arrow direction once at the moment of hover, in .75s cubic-bezier(.19,1,.22,1), and the same arrow hidden on the opposite side comes in and stands — it does not return on release and can push again only after .5s has passed. A down (↓), left or up arrow pushes in that direction

options.dir: Arrow direction — right (default)·down·left·up. Pushes that way
options.hold: Seconds before you can push again after one push, default .5
options.ease: Curve — a CSS name or four cubic-bezier numbers, default 0.19,1,0.22,1

use: In detail — to add the letter roll as well, set data-fx="char-roll box-arrow-slide" data-fx-char-roll="mode: once; dur: 1; ease: 0.19,1,0.22,1" Text on Toward
note: Box ([data-fx-part=arrow-box]) size, background and border are set by the css of the side using it — the part only builds the inner art in two copies and pushes it. Not applied on touch devices.

from.where: shared.css .c-box — header menu (↓) · black square button · region name · map button · footer link (original .btnbox--right/down ::before·::after, btnbox_hover_right .75s cubic-bezier(.19,1,.22,1) 0s 1 normal both, .hover 500ms)
